info.text:
In 2025, Amazon's ads made more money than all of Netflix.

Amazon's ad sales hit $68.6B in 2025, versus Netflix's total 2025 revenue of $45.2B.
Ad sales grew from $12.6B in 2019, more than 5x in six years.
In Q2 2026, ads brought in $19.8B (+26% year over year), about 9.9% of Amazon's $200.6B in sales.
The biggest piece is "Sponsored" listings in search results that sellers pay for per click.

Sources: Amazon 10-K filings and Q2 2026 earnings release, Netflix Q4 2025 letter, Meta FY2025 10-K, Alphabet Q4 2025 results.
News and education, not financial advice.
